name: Financial Institution Identification 5 Choice
definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

BIC.name: BIC
BIC.definition: Code allocated to a financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.name: Clearing System Member Identification
ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a clearing system member, as assigned by the system or system administrator.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Identifies the name and address of a financial institution.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to a financial institution using a proprietary identification scheme.

CombinedIdentification.name: Combined Identification
CombinedIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a financial institution, through a combimation of globally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.
